recentItems.title: How the Indian Right Wing Punishes Women Protesters
recentItems.description:
When Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi described political protesters as “our daughters” and said he forgave them, it revealed what happens when a woman becomes publicly angry at political power.

A 15-year-old girl who joined protests to challenge the flaws in Modi’s government faced severe doxxing and threats. 

Her case shows us a wider politics in which women who become publicly angry can be subjected to sexualized punishment and forced to apologize publicly for her transgressions.
